Daisho Case spawn (Common: houses, garages, etc.)

<RGB:0,1,0>How often the sealed Legendary Daisho Case appears in houses, garages, etc. (very rarely). A daisho is the traditional samurai pair of a katana and a wakizashi: the case holds both with their sheaths, all of the same color.
0 = never, 1 = extremely rare, 5 = default, 10 = 3 times the default.
Daisho Case spawn (Rare: police, military, antiques, etc.)

<RGB:0,1,0>How often the sealed Legendary Daisho Case appears in police stations, military sites, antique stores and survivor stashes. A daisho is the traditional samurai pair of a katana and a wakizashi: the case holds both with their sheaths, all of the same color.
0 = never, 1 = extremely rare, 5 = default, 10 = 3 times the default.

<RGB:0,1,0>How often loose legendary katanas drop from zombies.
0 = never, 1 = extremely rare, 5 = default, 10 = 3 times the default.

<RGB:0,1,0>How often the magazine that teaches the recipes appears (bookshelves, magazine racks, survivor houses, zombies...).
0 = never, 1 = extremely rare, 5 = default, 10 = 3 times the default.
